scene_timeline.visual_description: The creator, Justin Seymour, stands on the tee box of the 9th hole at a golf course, preparing for his drive. He holds a golf club and gestures as he speaks, with a golf ball teed up in front of him. The background shows a lush green fairway under a clear sky at dusk.
scene_timeline.audio_description: The creator talks about the 9th hole having sentimental value from high school matches and discusses his club selection, opting for a 3-wood over a driver to avoid a 300-yard water hazard.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Justin executes a powerful golf swing with his 3-wood, sending the golf ball flying down the fairway. An animated yellow line traces the trajectory of the ball.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Sound of a golf swing and the ball being hit.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Justin is now on the fairway, closer to the green, assessing his next shot. He holds a different golf club and looks towards the hole, with a large clubhouse visible in the background.
scene_timeline.audio_description: The creator discusses the distance to the middle pin (105 yards) and his plan to use a 52-degree wedge with a three-quarter swing.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Justin performs a controlled golf swing with his 52-degree wedge. An animated yellow line again shows the ball's flight path, landing near the hole.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Sound of a golf swing and the ball being hit. The creator comments that the shot was 'just a little bit' off but 'not so bad'.

scene_timeline.visual_description: On the green, Justin carefully lines up a putt. He is bent over, focused on the golf ball and the hole, holding a putter.
scene_timeline.audio_description: The creator describes the putt as downhill and left-to-right, emphasizing the need for good pace. Sound of the putter hitting the ball.

scene_timeline.visual_description: The golf ball rolls past the hole, and Justin bends down to retrieve it. The background shows the golf course and distant lights.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Sound of the ball rolling past the hole. The creator sighs in slight disappointment.

parsed_output.overall_summary: This video features golfer Justin Seymour playing the 9th hole at Arrowhead South, a course that holds sentimental value from his high school golf matches. He demonstrates strategic club selection by choosing a 3-wood for his tee shot to avoid a 300-yard water hazard. Justin then executes a precise 105-yard approach shot to the green with a 52-degree wedge. Despite a well-played approach, his final putt narrowly misses the hole, concluding his round with a positive attitude.

people.description: Young male with blonde curly hair, wearing a white baseball cap, a maroon polo shirt with a subtle pattern, grey shorts, and white golf shoes. He is the creator of the video, demonstrating golf techniques and providing commentary.

takeaways.statement: Strategic club selection is crucial in golf to navigate course hazards and optimize shot placement.
Even with good approach shots, putting requires precision and can be challenging.
